nv-clark-2026-dcfam-w-rocheleau-stacy.name: Stacy Rocheleau
nv-clark-2026-dcfam-w-rocheleau-stacy.bio: Family law attorney who started her own firm in 2004 and has sat as a Family Court Truancy Diversion Program judge and Discovery Commissioner Pro Tem.

nv-lasvegas-2026-muni1-walker-matt.name: Matt Walker
nv-lasvegas-2026-muni1-walker-matt.bio: Las Vegas Municipal Court judge who presides over the Veteran's Treatment Court; former Senior Deputy City Attorney with the Las Vegas City Attorney's Office.

positions.stance: Believes "justice is not a destination, but a constant, demanding process that requires addressing not just the symptoms of crime, but its root causes."

nv-lasvegas-2026-muni2-green-jessica.name: Jessica A. Green
nv-lasvegas-2026-muni2-green-jessica.bio: Pro Tem Judge in Las Vegas Municipal Court since 2019 and former Interim Hearing Master, with more than 15 years of legal experience in civil litigation, employment law and professional liability.

nv-lasvegas-2026-muni2-murphy-allycia.name: Allycia Murphy
nv-lasvegas-2026-muni2-murphy-allycia.bio: Attorney with courtroom experience in Las Vegas Municipal Court, including time as a prosecutor.
